description: Replace one exact piece of an issue's body on the server, without sending the whole body. 'old' is matched as a case-sensitive substring (it may span a whole line) and must occur exactly once: zero matches or several refuse with the body left unchanged, and several report the count. 'old' must not be empty. Pull request indexes are refused. Limitation: Forgejo has no compare-and-swap for issue edits, so an edit made between this call's read and write can be lost; compare updated_at in the result to detect that.

new.description: Text that replaces 'old'. May be empty to delete it.

old.description: Exact text to find in the body (case-sensitive, non-empty). Must occur exactly once.

name: replace_issue_body_line
